summary: Preserve cancellation and deadlines in signing gateway readiness
details: Preserve context cancellation and elapsed deadlines even before context notification; an expired probe cannot report healthy, and transport/body cancellation identities are retained.
Keep unrelated provider failures generic, close failed response bodies, and preserve authenticated read-only probes, endpoint restrictions, redirect rejection and response limits.
Add deterministic request, body and decoding regressions for delayed context notification while retaining the existing real HTTP deadline and canceled-request assertions.

compatibility.notes: Corrects internal readiness error identity without changing routes, configuration, signing behavior or stored evidence.

security: Return only context or generic availability sentinels; provider URLs, credentials and response details remain omitted. Authentication, destination and response-boundary checks are unchanged.
limitations: Readiness remains an availability signal and does not verify a signing operation or establish external provider assurance.
